text: 港股半导体板块午后持续走低，澜起科技(06809.HK)跌超23%，兆易创新(03986.HK)跌超9%，华虹宏力(01347.HK)跌超6%，中芯国际(00981.HK)、晶门半导体(02878.HK)等跟跌。
text_en: Hong Kong-listed semiconductor stocks continued to decline in the afternoon session, with Montage Technology (06809.HK) falling over 23%, GigaDevice (03986.HK) falling over 9%, Hua Hong Semiconductor (01347.HK) falling over 6%, and SMIC (00981.HK) and Solomon Systech (02878.HK) following.
